timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Yeah, that's a massive part of winning competition, winning Grand Finals, winning the FFA Cup.
It's about being together. There's been teams that aren't so prepared and aren't so fit, but because they're together they can achieve great things.
So I guess that balance between getting our fitness, competition for positions.
We've got two players for every position, so yeah, it's a very competitive environment, but very enjoyable, very challenging.
There's no easy training. Everybody wants to win every activity that we're involved in.
But again, there's a good balance with having fun as well, enjoying what you're doing.
Because we should love our job, if you can call it that.
I've always been more of a jovial person, but again, I'm a winner.
I want to win things I've done that before, and I want to bring that to this team as well.
And I want to go out. The young players coming through.
Again, there's such a balance in this squad. You've got the young fellows and the middle age, and then in more experience, plus 30s.
And I guess collectively, I just want to show them how to be successful, along with what the coaching staff are trying to provide.
But again, I want to make them feel relaxed as well, so I always try to do that with every squad that I've played in.
Because I love what I do, and it makes me happiest when I'm on the field.
